description: This file is a shell script used for managing GRE tunnels, configuring network interfaces, and setting system events related to Hotspot and GRE tunnel management within a network device.

methods.name: init_snooper_sysevents
methods.description: Initializes snooper-related system events by enabling circuit and remote snooper features.

methods.name: read_init_params
methods.description: Retrieves initial configuration parameters from PSM database for GRE tunnel and hotspot settings.

methods.name: create_tunnel
methods.description: Sets up GRE tunnels and network bridges, configures virtual interfaces, and adds interfaces to bridges for hotspot networking.

methods.name: init_keepalive_sysevents
methods.description: Configures system events related to keepalive settings for hotspot primary and secondary endpoints.

methods.name: update_bridge_config
methods.description: Configures iptables rules for forwarding and NAT related to the hotspot and GRE tunnel.
